items.summary: Recommendation: approve a bounded onboarding proposal for howtofry.com, but do not build, publish, configure BlueSky, analytics, affiliate links, or spend yet. Evidence: the owner request defines a frying-products Amazon affiliate concept with guides and recipes, while active delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and no howtofry.com registry, launch-readiness, legal, security, analytics, or BlueSky evidence exists. Unknowns: content scope, affiliate tag, account ownership, launch budget, compliance/security gates, and expected revenue are not calculable. Smallest next step: approve the onboarding scope so CTO, Legal, Security, CFO, and site-factory can produce a bounded readiness packet. Owner decision: approve or reject onboarding under EXEC_CONV_10.
